```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
measels <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(measels))
ggplot(measels, aes(
  x = date,
    y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "pink") +
  xlab("Week") +
  ylab("Cases") +
  ggtitle("Measels cases per week")
                  
```
